conventions.teams: stable franchise ids (franchise_events_1970_2025.json); names as in nfl_seasons_1970_1980.json
conventions.date: game date as PFR lists it (csk of the date cell)
conventions.pfr_time: kick-off time as PFR prints it; the time zone is not stated on the page
conventions.home: the team whose code ends the PFR box-score id (/boxscores/YYYYMMDD0<home>.htm); agrees with PFR's '@' location mark for every game
conventions.order: PFR's order: by week, then as PFR lists the week's games
conventions.scores: real results, for reference and checks only; the runtime schedule.csv carries no scores

sources.title: 2012 NFL Record & Fact Book, "Past Standings" (1980: p. 387)
